source_caption:
The Iron Claw is one of those movies that gets even more heartbreaking when you realize how much of it is true. The Von Erich brothers had fame, success and each other, but behind the wrestling was a family hit by an unimaginable amount of tragedy. Watching them lose one brother after another makes the story feel less like a wrestling movie and more like a story about grief, brotherhood and trying to keep your family together when everything keeps falling apart.

Zac Efron is incredible as Kevin Von Erich. He carries so much of the emotion without overplaying it, especially in the quieter moments where you can see the weight of everything Kevin has been through. There’s something devastating about watching him try to hold his family together while slowly losing almost everyone around him. One of Efron’s most affecting performances, and easily one of the most overlooked.

🎥: The Iron Claw (2023)
Dir. Sean Durkin

source_details.synopsis: The Iron Claw is a 2023 biographical sports drama film written and directed by Sean Durkin about the Von Erichs, a family of professional wrestlers beset by tragedy. The film depicts the struggles of wrestling company owner Fritz Von Erich's sons to achieve the success for which their father groomed them, from 1979 to the early 1990s. The film stars Zac Efron as Kevin Von Erich alongside Jeremy Allen White, Harris Dickinson, Maura Tierney, Stanley Simons, Holt McCallany, and Lily James as other members of the family. The title comes from the "Iron Claw", a signature move of the Von Erichs, which takes on thematic resonance within the film. The Iron Claw premiered at the Texas Theatre in Dall
